rust_implementation.placement: programme_v3_1 dependency rule: the quantifier is shared by the environment accessor, the design layer (statewise_envelope) and the assessment layer (HC-08), so it sits below abep-design / abep-assess in the physics crate the plan names for SC-WP-04. It is a quantifier over caller-supplied margins: it holds no requirement value and reads no requirement record; any criterion is the caller's margin function. No raw-physics output of abep-mission calls it (the statewise T - D record is raw quantities only)

inputs.harness: scripts/rust_migration/parity_sc_wp04.py (committed after this contract and before the scoring run)
inputs.vector_shape: one vector = requirement_id, a list of state dicts (state_id and, where registered, weight) and one registered margin outcome per state: a float, an int, a bool, a non-finite float, a string / null (DE only) or a raise [class, message]. Python: margin_fn(state) returns the outcome or raises <class>(message) (classes RuntimeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError); Rust CLI: the closure returns the outcome or Err('<class>: <message>'). The outcome of state j is looked up by position j
inputs.transport: JSON; non-finite floats as the strings 'NaN', '+inf', '-inf' (these three strings always denote floats)
inputs.design_states: S_i, i = 0..195: intake_synthesis.required_states() in file order (state_id, rho_kg_m3, T_K, alt_km)

edge_cases.note: negative zero passes; worst margin copied (-0.0)
ties: the first minimum is the worst state
int weights; average >= 0 while FAIL: average_hides_violation true
partially weighted: no sum check, no average
a non-string state_id is echoed as given
an error and a failure: verdict MODEL_ERROR, n_fail 1
fully weighted with an error: no average
zero weights allowed when the sum is positive

inputs.edge_case_defaults: state_ids 's0', 's1', ... unless set; no weight key unless weights are set (null = key present with null value); requirement_id 'PARITY-EDGE'

entries.draw: per vector in order: n = rng_0.integers(1, 41); weight_mode = rng_0.integers(0, 4); then per state j = 0..n-1 in order: weight (mode 0: none; mode 1: rng_0.uniform(0.0, 10.0); mode 2: present iff rng_0.uniform() < 0.5, then rng_0.uniform(0.0, 10.0), else no weight key; mode 3: 0.0 if rng_0.uniform() < 0.3 else rng_0.uniform(0.0, 10.0)); kind = rng_0.integers(0, 20): 0-14 float rng_0.uniform(-1.0, 1.0), 15-16 bool rng_0.integers(0, 2) == 1, 17 int rng_0.integers(-3, 4), 18 non-finite [NaN, +inf, -inf][rng_0.integers(0, 3)], 19 raise [('RuntimeError', 'boom <j>'), ('ValueError', 'bad <j>'), ('ZeroDivisionError', 'float division by zero')][rng_0.integers(0, 3)]; state_id 's<j>'; requirement_id 'REQ-R<k>' (k vector index). A vector whose weight mode is 3 and whose weights are all 0.0 is scored as RAISED (ValueError) like DE-B-08

list.name: verdict, n_states, n_fail, n_model_error, orbit_average_note, average_hides_violation, authority
list.definition: as the reference: verdict MODEL_ERROR if any error else PASS iff no FAIL; average_hides_violation = average reported and >= 0 and verdict != PASS

list.name: per_state (state_id, margin, pass, status) and worst_state
list.tolerance: equal (margins are copied: float(m), or 0.0 / -1.0 for bools; null for errors)
list.definition: status PASS / FAIL / MODEL_ERROR per state; worst = the first state of minimum margin among non-null margins

list.name: errors
list.definition: [{state_id, error}] with error '<class>: <message>' for a raising margin function or 'non-finite margin'

list.name: orbit_average_margin
list.definition: sum(float(w) * margin) / sum(float(w)), both sums left to right from 0; null unless every state is weighted and no error occurred

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, booleans, null, statuses, error classes / messages, key sets and order, and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats by bit pattern)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py); ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) for normal py, the smallest subnormal for py = 0 or subnormal py; no relative or absolute clause

tolerance_basis.registered: k_ulp = 4 (template proposal); the average is IEEE basic operations in the reference order (plain left-to-right sums under Python 3.11), bit identity expected

exact_invariants.statement: n_states == len(per_state); n_fail == count(status FAIL); n_model_error == len(errors) == count(status MODEL_ERROR); verdict PASS iff n_fail == 0 and n_model_error == 0
the orbit average never enters the verdict: verdict equals the verdict of the same vector with every weight removed
double-run determinism: two Rust processes give byte-identical stdout; two Python evaluations give equal results
fail closed: a raising or non-finite margin is MODEL_ERROR for its state (never skipped, never PASS)

documented_divergence.statement: a margin function returning a numeric string (float('1.5')) is evaluated by the reference; Rust parses a string margin with the Python float() grammar for decimal / inf / nan literals and refuses anything else with the reference's ValueError text
documented_divergence.disposition: only the non-numeric string of DE-B-12 is registered; numeric-string margins are not scored

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector meets its tolerance class; every outcome / error class / message equals the reference outcome
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED, PARITY_FAIL <=> NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for this component (within the registered domain); the Python component may then be retired from active execution. It is NOT physics validation and closes no requirement: HC-08 stays an assessment (SC-WP-11) and is NOT_EVALUATED while thrust or spacecraft drag are not evaluated.
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture code; no excluded legacy path (RM-R20)
decision_rules.scoring_once: the scoring comparison runs once (scoring_master_seed); the harness refuses a second scoring run when parity_report_v1.json exists
